title: 第一卷 第15章 曾经的安阳村天才第一卷 第16章 逆天噬经诡异的长生经
content_zh:
黑夜，林罪从竹林回来。
一进门，李群书就一脸幽怨的说道，“罪哥，和你想的一样，现在杂役弟子分成了好几波，还要收保护费，估计过几天就要找到我们了，保护费是十个黑面团。”
林罪刚要说话，敲门声响起。
两人对视一眼。
林罪站起身，凑上前，透过门大大的缝隙，可以看到外面的人。
二十出头的年纪，穿一身外门弟子的青色长袍，袖口绣着云纹，腰间挂着一柄长剑。
个头比林罪高小半个头，肩膀很宽，脸晒得有点黑，长相普通。
这张脸，林罪认得，而且还算熟悉。
他打开门，冲着来人微微一笑。
青年看向林罪，整张脸绽开一个巨大的笑容。
这个笑容很真实，不似李福满那种伪笑。
“林罪！”
青年一把抓住林罪的肩膀，“真是你？我刚才敲门的时候还怕找错了屋，怕你不在，怕同名同姓。”
“祁云哥，”林罪的声音也有些变化。
祁云，安阳村人。
三年前，安阳村唯一一个被测出仙骨雏形的少年。
两道仙骨，轰动全村。
祁云比他大两岁，那会儿算是全村孩子的大哥哥，有啥好吃的，好玩的，都会想着他们这群孩子。
即使林罪是孩子王，很调皮，但在祁云面前，还是很老实的。
“云哥，你怎么知道我在这儿？”

祁云笑了笑。
“我昨天听到外门师兄弟谈论内门殿主关门弟子之事。”
“一听名字，我觉得耳熟，这不是当年跟在你屁股后头那个小鼻涕虫吗？”
“后面侥幸看到她，她也看到我，是她告诉我的。”
林罪点了点头，“她现在是内门殿主的关门弟子了。”
“我知道，”祁云的语气里带着一种感慨，“五骨雏形，太曦之体，内门殿主亲自收徒，咱们安阳村那种穷地方，能出这么一个人物，说出去都没人信。”
“太曦之体？”
林罪一愣，她什么时候多出个太曦之体了？
这种体质在老夫子的笔记里也提到过，未来最低也是百骨人仙。
体质和天生仙骨雏形多的人一样，天地的宠儿。
祁云点了点头，“林罪，有一句话得提醒你一下，从今天开始，保持和诗涵的距离。”
content_en:
In the dark night, Lin Zui came back from the bamboo forest.
As soon as he entered the door, Li Qunshu said with a look of resentment, "Brother Zui, just as you thought, the handyman disciples are divided into several waves now, and they have to collect protection fees. It is estimated that they will find us in a few days, and the protection fee is ten black dough."
Just as Lin Zui was about to speak, there was a knock on the door.
The two looked at each other.
Lin Zui stood up and came forward. Through the large gap in the door, he could see the people outside.
He was in his early twenties, wearing a green robe of an outer disciple, with cloud patterns embroidered on the cuffs, and a long sword hanging on his waist.
He was half a head taller than Lin Zui, with broad shoulders, a tanned face, and ordinary appearance.
Lin Zui recognized this face, and it was quite familiar.
He opened the door and smiled at the visitor.
The young man looked at Lin Zui, a huge smile spread across his face.
This smile is very real, not like Li Fuman's fake smile.
"Lin Sin!"
The young man grabbed Lin Zui's shoulder, "Is it really you? When I knocked on the door just now, I was afraid that I had found the wrong house, that you were not here, and that I had the same name."
"Brother Qi Yun," Lin Zui's voice also changed somewhat.
Qi Yun is from Anyang Village.
Three years ago, he was the only boy in Anyang Village whose prototype of immortal bones was detected.
The two immortal bones shocked the whole village.
Qi Yun was two years older than him. At that time, he was considered the eldest brother of all the children in the village. Whenever there was something delicious or fun to do, he would always think of these children.
Even though Lin Zui is the king of children and very naughty, he is still very honest in front of Qi Yun.
"Brother Yun, how do you know I'm here?"
Qi Yun smiled.
"Yesterday I heard the outer sect brothers talking about the inner sect master shutting down his disciples."
"When I heard the name, I thought it sounded familiar. Isn't this the little slug that followed you back then?"
"I was lucky enough to see her later, and she also saw me. She told me."
Lin Zui nodded, "She is now the closed disciple of the master of the inner sect."
"I know," Qi Yun said with emotion in his tone, "The prototype of the five bones, the body of Taixi, the master of the inner gate hall personally recruits disciples, no one will believe that such a character can come out of a poor place like our Anyang Village."
"The body of Tai Xi?"
Lin Zui was stunned. When did she get a body of Tai Xi?
This kind of physique was also mentioned in the old master's notes, and in the future, the lowest level will be a hundred-bone human immortal.
The physique is the same as that of a person born with many prototypes of immortal bones, and he is the darling of heaven and earth.
Qi Yun nodded, "Lin Zui, I have to remind you that from today on, keep your distance from Shihan."
